sources.title: Lunar Prospector GRS Elemental Abundance V1.0
sources.reading_scope: Archive introduction, full dataset.cat, PDS4 identifier and all field descriptions; every row of the 5-degree table parsed. Exact bytes and hashes in lunar_inputs.json.
sources.claims: Peer-reviewed archive of oxide mass fractions and formal covariance; metadata label revision 2024-07-09 changes XML schema syntax only.
sources.limits: Surface composition; no mineral extraction, deposit depth or economic reserve. The older special-products archive is not substituted.

sources.title: Elemental composition of the lunar surface: Analysis of gamma ray spectroscopy data from Lunar Prospector
sources.reading_scope: Introduction and data description; formal covariance and systematic errors paragraphs 63–67; Si/Ca discussion paragraphs 95–96; conclusions.
sources.claims: Shallow sensing, approximately five-degree resolution; covariance beyond diagonal variances; documented systematic errors and nonclosure.
sources.limits: Formal covariance omits systematic uncertainty and does not rigorously model every constraint. Spatial cells are not demonstrated independent.

sources.title: Lunar Sourcebook Table 7.15: Chemical compositions of lunar soils
sources.reading_scope: Two-page PDF and ASCII table, sample/site columns and references.
sources.claims: Contextual mare/highland sampled-composition contrasts; institutional compilation, not new original analysis.
sources.limits: Original measurement papers not separately read; apparent Na2O and phosphorus-label transcription errors preclude silent automatic ingestion; not consumed by this model.

sources.title: Detection of Water in the LCROSS Ejecta Plume
sources.reading_scope: Abstract, Table 1 journal page 465/PDF page 4, interpretation and limitations journal page 467/PDF page 6.
sources.claims: Cabeus observed-ejecta water estimate 5.6 ± 2.9 wt%; site-specific depth/footprint/heating limitations.
sources.limits: No polar reserve or full geological confidence distribution; full article not redistributed.

sources.title: Direct evidence of surface exposed water ice in the lunar polar regions
sources.reading_scope: Abstract, distribution discussion, Figure 4 and Methods.
sources.claims: Approximately 280 m optical-surface pixels; patchy ice exposure.
sources.limits: Surface exposure fraction and spectral mixing estimates do not determine excavatable depth, bulk water grade or permitted access.

sources.title: Modeling energy requirements for oxygen production on the Moon
sources.reading_scope: Tables 1–2, discussion, mass-yield/energy methods, reactor assumptions PDF pages 5–9.
sources.claims: Grade/enrichment-sensitive hydrogen-reduction chain; 24.3±5.8 kWh/kg LOX at 10 wt% ilmenite. Reported spread derives from chosen parameter ranges, not plant measurements.
sources.limits: Oxygen-led model not finished-metal energy calibration; 100% uptime assumed. No process coefficient adopted by lunar.py.

sources.title: Progress Review of NASA Lunar ISRU Development, 2019 to 2025
sources.reading_scope: Slides 6–9 on oxygen/metal and polar-water demonstrations.
sources.limits: No mature industrial cost, equipment-lifetime or universal recovery calibration.

sources.title: Abridged Standard Atomic Weights 2024
sources.reading_scope: Table rows O, Al, Ti, Fe and applicability/version notes.
sources.claims: Standard atomic weights allow explicit oxide-to-contained-element stoichiometry.
sources.limits: Not chemical mineralogy or extraction recovery; constants not used by this parser.

sources.title: System Modeling of a Lunar Molten Regolith Electrolysis Plant
sources.reading_scope: Full NTRS abstract and linked one-page poster.
sources.claims: Model considers metal alloys alongside oxygen but omits downstream metal processing and beneficiation.
sources.limits: No finished-metal industrial cost calibration from this bounded source review.

local_boundary: The enclosed-mining source register and conservation README principles/D5 were read. No polar water supply is admitted; science/heritage and site access require separate treatment.
